'''Jee Sallis''' was a diminutive [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Sallis worked as a crewman on the [[comet broom ship]], a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that destroyed or diverted the courses of rogue [[Comet/Legends|comets]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], and she was also a good friend of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Selima DeWitt]]. In about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], DeWitt moved to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Gadrin]] without informing her father, [[Davin DeWitt]], who subsequently hired a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] to find his daughter. Sallis was present in the [[platform city]] [[Bayonard]] during the agents' investigation and after hearing that the party were looking for DeWitt, she informed them of her friend's location.
